If you want one speech-to-text tool that covers dictation and file uploads, pick Voicy. If you want a product that feels most like Willow, look at Wispr Flow. If your speech usually needs cleanup before it looks good on screen, Typeless is more interesting.

If privacy is the main issue, Superwhisper deserves the harder look. If price is the issue, start with Windows Voice Typing and move up only if you outgrow it.
